candidates.title: Bounded pairwise-softmax activation shapes hard-negative gradients

primary_sources.title: PSL: Rethinking and Improving Softmax Loss from Pairwise Perspective for Recommendation

candidates.source_mechanism: Replace exponential pair-gap activation with 1+tanh(d); source ranking-bound argument uses bounded pair gaps
candidates.experiment: Identical two-layer width-64 MLP with .5*tanh output, same fixed-C positive/negative masks: exact exponential loss versus PSL-tanh, tau=.2. Average over covered positives then informative queries; exclude other positives
inputs: Mature purchase labels for future allowed training
candidates.fit_availability: All standalone learner/scaler fit on allowed train; training X strict-past; model complete before first evaluation anchor; no representation feature exported to earlier anchors
candidates.counterhypothesis: Suppressing hardest negatives removes rare useful purchase signal; bounded scorer underfits B41
candidates.novelty_difference: Existing PairLogit/CE/sampler/temperature studies preserve gradient activation; this changes relative gradient shape while retaining scorer, sampler and inputs
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Zero-fit source-free fixtures: translation invariance, finite-difference gradients, empty/all-positive masks, same-tau gradient-allocation difference
candidates.matched_baseline: Exact-C exponential-softmax same bounded MLP, plus paid fresh B41 with frozen parameters
transfer_limits: CF latent relevance versus daily purchase-set target
Bound theorem not asserted for adapted multi-positive full-Y NDCG
candidates.stop_rule: Stop at resource cap or failed semantic/gradient gate; no promotion without matched-MLP gain and strong-B41 challenge

candidates.title: Parameter-sharing ensemble diversity on fixed tabular inputs

primary_sources.title: TabM: Advancing Tabular Deep Learning with Parameter-Efficient Ensembling

candidates.source_mechanism: Shared MLP weights with member-specific multiplicative adapters/separate independently supervised heads, averaged at inference
candidates.experiment: Width-64 two-layer MLP versus same-width k=8 TabM; mean per-head query-weighted BCE, mean probabilities for fixed-C ranking
inputs: All mature candidate groups including zero-purchase
candidates.fit_availability: Standalone preprocessing/learner fit on permitted train; strict-past X; learner and averaging policy frozen before evaluation
candidates.counterhypothesis: Shared heads are too correlated and add CPU without useful diversity; one MLP uses scarce labels more efficiently
candidates.novelty_difference: M05 changes candidate-conditioned history; M08 hybrid representation. This holds inputs/history fixed and changes independently supervised parameter-sharing predictions; no extra event heads
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Source-free k=1 reduction, independent head losses, correct average-before-ranking. Separately paid <=1000 label-blind training-Q forward/backward cost gate with dummy labels and no optimizer update or quality look
candidates.matched_baseline: Single same-width MLP with same loss/input transform and paid fresh strong B41
candidates.memory_arithmetic: 5.317m x 41 x 4 bytes about .812 GiB, numeric values only; no eightfold stored input copies; stream blocks; activations scale with k
transfer_limits: Paper tuning and many-seed budget excluded
Shared-head variance not calibrated epistemic uncertainty
candidates.stop_rule: Stop on cap; mechanism fails without gain over matched MLP; no promotion without strong-B41 quality/resource comparison

candidates.title: Isolate teacher supervision from deployed purchase logit

primary_sources.title: Bridging the Gap: Unpacking the Hidden Challenges in Knowledge Distillation for Online Ranking Systems

candidates.source_mechanism: Separate hard-label and teacher-label logits to reduce direct bias leakage; paper additionally uses continuously refreshed online teachers
candidates.experiment: Prefix-trained B41 teacher soft labels on chronologically later student train blocks. Identical MLP students: purchase only; direct same-logit purchase plus teacher; separate deployed purchase head plus auxiliary teacher head. Lambda=.1, temperature=1; discard teacher head
inputs: Out-of-time teacher soft score and coverage mask used only as supervision
candidates.fit_availability: Teacher completed and prefix labels matured before first student block; teacher scores never inference features; all student fits finish before evaluation
candidates.counterhypothesis: Teacher is stale/weaker and biases still reach shared trunk; separate head wastes scarce support
candidates.novelty_difference: HYP065 purchase+any supervises observed event tasks. Here fixed teacher soft supervision is routed direct versus isolated head with identical labels/coverage/trunk
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Zero-fit analytic two-head shifted-teacher fixture verifies zero direct teacher-loss derivative on deployed purchase head, nonzero shared-trunk derivative. Reject if later training blocks cannot retain sufficient purchase support
candidates.matched_baseline: Direct distillation and no-distillation identical students; paid full-training B41 strong baseline
candidates.memory_plan: One float32 teacher soft score per candidate row plus keys/masks; streamed joins; teacher inference charged
transfer_limits: Months of online development/refresh not reproduced
candidates.stop_rule: Reject absent honest chronological support; ranker gain and actual inference cost must survive predeclared B41 quality tolerance

candidates.title: Recommendation-oriented joint hierarchical item tokenization

primary_sources.title: Generative Recommender with End-to-End Learnable Item Tokenization

candidates.source_mechanism: Sequence-item and preference-semantic alignment plus alternating optimization couples item tokenizer and conditional generator; source uses collaborative SASRec item embeddings
candidates.experiment: Equal-length hierarchical codes from pre-fitted collaborative item embeddings; identical conditional decoders with frozen tokenizer versus recommendation-aligned joint tokenizer. Score full fixed C by complete code log-probability; deterministic collision suffix. Average horizon purchase-set per-item code loss
inputs: Collaborative item embeddings fitted on earlier warmup
candidates.fit_availability: Collaborative embedding initialization before downstream training anchors; joint code/decoder standalone model fit uses only permitted train; final vocabulary/code map/decoder freeze together before evaluation. No downstream B feature export
candidates.counterhypothesis: One month and few purchases cannot train semantic partitions; tail collisions and sparse supervision overwhelm alignment; code likelihood gain fails full-Y ranking
candidates.novelty_difference: Existing sequence/pooling/graph/ALS branches do not jointly learn the item partition and its conditional decoder; this changes representation token assignment, not merely sequence architecture
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Zero-fit hand code trie verifies collision suffix uniqueness, OOV masks, complete code scores and coherent item-code-decoder lineage; reject inconsistent joint update before fits
candidates.matched_baseline: Same decoder/history/initial embeddings/tokenizer but frozen codes, plus paid B41. Fixed-C test does not claim beam retrieval coverage
transfer_limits: Paper Amazon 5-core per-user leave-one-out next-item setting differs
Author CUDA PyTorch and pretrained SASRec/RQVAE downloads inadmissible automatically
No claim CPU procedure completes within proposal cap
Horizon set loss and fixed-C scoring explicit adaptations
candidates.stop_rule: Defer; stop on code lineage/cost failure; promote only joint-vs-frozen code ranking gain and strong-B41 comparison
